exploit_name: TWAMM instant orders can steal historical rewards via unregistered start time
description: When orders are created at block.timestamp == startTime, the start time isn't registered in the time bitmap, causing rewardRatesBeforeSlot to remain uninitialized.
root_cause: When orders are created at block.timestamp == startTime, the start time isn't registered in the time bitmap, causing rewardRatesBeforeSlot to remain uninitialized.
fix_description: Register start time in bitmap even when block.timestamp equals startTime.
notes: Instant orders capture rewards from periods before they existed.
